mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS seq, u.username AS id, u.password AS pw, u.ssn, u.phone_number AS phoneNumber, u.nickname, u.real_name AS name, u.email, u.address, u.gender, u.height, u.weight, u.health_goals AS healthGoals, ( SELECT s.status FROM tblUserStatus s WHERE s.user_status_id = u.user_status_id ) AS auth FROM tblUser u WHERE u.username = #{username}
